Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Mon, Nov 2 7:28am to 6:23pm; Tue, Nov 3 7:30am to 6:22pm; Wed, Nov 4 7:31am to 6:20pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Mon, Nov 2 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Quiet Monday. Pam Rocks read NNE 16 at 6am and has sat at 15 to 17 since 2am, well short of the 22 Porteau needs. Environment Canada has backed off to northerly 20 to 30, easing to 15 to 20 near noon, and the page keeps Porteau under 3, so I don't think it builds.

I'm not driving anywhere today. If Pam Rocks jumps to 22 or more from the north before 9am, Porteau is worth a look, but don't count on it. Squamish is an outflow, and showers come this afternoon.

Tuesday looks light too.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 AM PCT 02 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Today Tonight and Tuesday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 20 to 30 knots diminishing to northerly outflow 15 to 20 near noon. Wind northerly outflow 15 to 20 tonight and Tuesday.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 AM PCT 02 November 2026): Today Tonight and Tuesday. Wind southeast 10 knots becoming light early this afternoon then becoming northwest 5 to 15 Tuesday morning.
